subject: RFP: Data safeguards & cross-border controls — Stratagem Health
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stratagemhealth.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@stratagemhealth.com
Date: 2026-10-01T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFP: Data safeguards & cross-border controls — Stratagem Health

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for taking this RFP. We're running a formal procurement for inference vendors and need a concise technical & contractual package focused on cross-border transfers and processor safeguards. Key asks from our procurement and privacy teams: 

- Completed DPA annex (we will share our template) with clear export controls and subprocessor commitments.
- Evidence of Data Protection Framework (DPF) controls: encryption at rest/in transit, key management, operational segregation, and audit logs.
- Clarify whether Redwood relies on SCCs (or equivalent) for EU→US flows and how you implement contractual and technical safeguards.
- KMS/HSM custody model and whether customers can provide their own keys (BYOK).
- Data residency options / dedicated deployments and a mapping of what flows to Redwood-hosted regions.
- SOC 2 or equivalent attestation.

Would you be able to provide a single consolidated package (DPA annex draft + evidence index + sample artifacts) by Friday, Oct 3? We have an internal deadline for supplier shortlisting on Oct 7. I've attached the RFP instructions which include our timeline and scoring.

Also please note the procurement team may request a secure upload for any sensitive artifacts.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Senior Procurement Manager
Stratagem Health
Attachments: RFP-Instructions-Stratagem.pdf
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stratagemhealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Data safeguards & cross-border controls — Stratagem Health

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list and timeline. We can deliver a consolidated response by EOD Friday Oct 3. High-level plan below and a suggested split of artifacts so you know where to find each item in the package:

What we'll provide by Oct 3:
- Draft DPA annex populated against your template (redlined where standard Redwood language differs).
- DPF Evidence Index (controls inventory and links to artifacts).
- KMS/HSM statement that covers BYOK, customer-managed keys in Redwood Private, and HSM-backed key wraps.
- SOC 2 Type II report summary and scope note.
- Dataflow map showing region routing rules and where processing occurs (hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).
- Retention and deletion playbook summary and sample audit log extract.

Quick clarifications for your team: 
1) For EU→US transfers we support: SCCs + documented supplementary measures (technical + contractual) and an option for Dedicated or Private deployment to avoid cross-border flows altogether.
2) BYOK is available for Redwood Private and for Dedicated through an HSM-backed gateway; hosted customers can use a managed KMS with customer key isolation options.

I'll attach an index now so you can confirm the scope; we'll follow with the full zip and a secure Drive link. Can we book a 30-minute review on Oct 4 to walk through any redlines?

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Sales, EU & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Hi Alicia / Stratagem legal team — attached is the consolidated package per your request. Below is a short index and next steps.

Package index (files attached / secure Drive):
- redwood-dpa-annex-draft.docx — DPA annex redline + clean copy (callouts for export clause and subprocessor flows).
- redwood-dpf-evidence-index.pdf — controls inventory with references to artifacts.
- kms-hsm-statement.pdf — describes BYOK options, HSM custody, and customer-key zeroization process.
- soc2-type2-summary.pdf — scope and auditor letter (full report available under NDA).
- dataflow-region-mapping.pdf — processing locations by workload and routing rules.
- retention-deletion-playbook.pdf — sample retention schedules and deletion runbook.

Key notes:
- EU→US Transfers: We rely on SCCs supplemented by documented technical and organisational measures. For customers requiring stronger isolation we recommend Redwood Dedicated or Redwood Private deployments; the DPA annex drafts the routing and fallback policies for each option.
- BYOK: Customer-managed keys supported for Private deployments; Dedicated can be configured with HSM-backed key wrappers. Hosted customers may opt for customer-key isolation via our managed KMS — details in the KMS statement.
- Evidence: we've included a log extract (anonymized) and the controls index; if you need raw artifacts we'll provision a secure upload under your vendor onboarding rules.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether you prefer: (A) a short Oct 4 review call (30 minutes) to walk the annex and KMS question, or (B) a follow-up redline round after your legal review. We'll keep the HubSpot record updated with your procurement milestone.

Secure links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3RedwoodDPF (access granted to your procurement group).
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DEAL-2026-1193

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
